description: Get a single rubric's definition (title, points_possible, criteria, and rating levels) by ID. Use list_rubrics to find the rubric_id for a course first. Pass include=["assignment_associations"] to also retrieve the rubric association IDs that submit_rubric_assessment needs, or include=["assessments"|"graded_assessments"|"peer_assessments"] for assessor_id-only assessment summaries (no assessor name is returned). This returns the rubric's structure, not any one student's completed assessment — use get_rubric_assessment for that. Requires the manage_rubrics permission in the course, so most students cannot call this.

include.description: Related Canvas records to include. Use assignment_associations to retrieve association IDs for linked assignments. Canvas honours only one association scope per request; extra association values are ignored.

name: get_rubric
title: Get Rubric
